text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I know a princess should be strong and resolute…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But at this rate, I don't even deserve to call myself one!
choice_data_list: Keep your chin up, brave princess.
A true princess would never give up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-you'd still call me a princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Hehe, that sounded just like something a prince would say.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! I need to stop acting like a drama queen! I'm a princess, and a princess always bounces back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. Now this princess can continue forward!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You're right, of course. If I want to become a true princess, I have to continue running ahead, never giving up!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No matter what wall stands in my way, I'll pulverize it with the ol' one-two punch-headbutt combo! That's what a princess does!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm going to start with some mental imagery training! Come on, Trainer, you join in too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Princess Hook! Princess Uppercut! PRINCESS HEADBUTT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After practicing around one hundred different moves, Kawakami Princess seems to be back in high spirits.
